state_rules.reservation: A SUBMITTED receipt for a non-duplicate binds the newly reserved immutable number.
state_rules.duplicate: DUPLICATE_LINKED binds the existing issue and preserves submitted reporter/evidence attribution.
state_rules.self_digest: receipt_sha256 is canonicalDigest with receipt_sha256 set to null.
state_rules.seam_finding: A material companion is submitted as a typed SEAM_FINDING or SCOPE_AMENDMENT and receives a stable issue ID linked to its READY root.
state_rules.scope_amendment: A scope amendment carries explicit Owner authority, same-root relation, bounded paths, and verification mapping.
state_rules.projection: A completed delivered submission is eligible for the full cleared-issues.md projection only after independent PASS and Runtime identity equality.
